title: You were told you need treatment and you're not sure
desc: I've spent 20 years doing complex restorative cases patients called 'lost causes.' If your diagnosis doesn't add up, bring it in. I'll review with no conflict of interest.

title: You want a written plan before anything irreversible happens
desc: No acting before you understand. I deliver a written treatment plan with options, timing, and pricing. You decide when you have the full picture.

title: You value materials and technique over speed or volume
desc: I use high-grade German composite and laboratory materials because durability matters more than finishing the day's quota.

title: You want a dentist who genuinely listens
desc: My first visits are for diagnosis and explanation, not for starting treatment. Time spent planning pays back tenfold.

title: You need a specialist referral without pressure to do everything in-house
desc: There is no such thing as a 'jack of all trades.' If your case needs a specialist, I refer you and coordinate the process.

title: You want clear pricing before starting
desc: I publish real pricing for standard procedures. For larger cases, I give you a written plan quote so you know what to expect.
